question: According to the Global Multidimensional Poverty Index 2022, which of the following states is NOT included in 10 poorest states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gujarat** is not included in the list of the 10 poorest states according to the Global Multidimensional Poverty Index 2022.
 
• The states included in the 10 poorest are predominantly from the central and eastern regions of India.
 
• The index measures poverty through various dimensions such as health, education, and standard of living, rather than just income.
 
• Gujarat has shown significant economic growth and development, which reflects in its exclusion from the list of the 10 poorest states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)** is a measure that takes into account various factors of poverty beyond just income, including deprivation in health, education, and living standards.
 
• The MPI is developed by the **Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI)** and the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)**.
 
• It provides a more comprehensive picture of poverty, highlighting areas where policy interventions can be targeted to improve the quality of life.
 
• India has made significant strides in reducing poverty, but disparities remain across different states and regions.
 
• States like Bihar, Jharkhand, and Uttar Pradesh are often highlighted in the MPI for their high levels of multidimensional poverty.
